svg.title: MarketLab stock data and research pipeline
svg.desc: Server Alpha Vantage requests, direct browser Alpha Vantage requests, and historical CSV imports converge on validation and immutable owner-scoped D1 price snapshots. Explicit corporate-action records feed exact accounting and backtests; the same saved price snapshots also support a separate portfolio-ledger accounting path. Saved private research reports support separate owner-triggered background recomputation with MongoDB leases and C++ checks, independent Python replay with report-bound receipts, or reviewed redacted public sharing.
svg.text: From stock prices to an inspectable result
Three input paths. Frozen private records. Separate actions for verification and sharing.
SERVER REQUEST
Alpha Vantage daily closes
IBM demo or configured server key
Bounded fetch; no automatic retry
BROWSER REQUEST
Direct provider connection
One-time key stays with the browser
Only normalized prices reach the app
FILE IMPORT
Historical price CSV
Declared source and adjustment basis
Historical or explicitly synthetic
Validate before saving
Symbol, USD, dates, positive prices, duplicates, size
Adjustment basis retained; browser data revalidated
Provider paths share one atomic owner cooldown
Freeze price snapshots in D1
Owner + SHA-256 identity; identical saves reuse it
Source, basis, origin, coverage and provider metadata
CSV and browser/provider provenance stay distinct
Bind inputs; calculate explicitly
Complete declared split/dividend records are required
Exact cash, fees, shares and split fractions
Backtests: next-close signals, costs, matched dates
Missing or incompatible inputs stop the calculation
Save the private research report
Worker computes the canonical TypeScript result
D1 retains frozen settings, inputs and outputs
Preview fingerprint is checked again before save
Private JSON / CSV exports preserve the full report
SEPARATE OWNER-TRIGGERED ACTIONS
Background recomputation
Signed snapshot copy → Node service
Bounded MongoDB jobs; fenced leases
Workers; C++ in native-check mode
Result remains in the research service
Independent Python replay
Full saved report → bounded verifier
Accounting, trades, signals and risk
Receipt bound to exact report bytes
Matching receipt stored against D1 run
Reviewed public summary
Explicit consent; allowlisted redaction
Expiring, replaceable, revocable link
Raw prices and private labels withheld
Sharing does not require either verifier
Daily historical data, not a live feed. Validation does not authenticate browser-supplied prices.
